headline: Share India Securities Limited: Issue of Securities
sum: Issue of Securities - Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please be informed that the Finance Committee at its meeting held today i.e., on October 26, 2026, approved the issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures of up…
detail: Issue of Securities - Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please be informed that the Finance Committee at its meeting held today i.e., on October 26, 2026, approved the issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures of up to Rs. 125 Crores including green shoe option of up to Rs. 50 Crores.

sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
